analysis.title: Identifying AI-Resilient Quality (ARQ) stocks
key_insights: UBS CIO expects AI to remain a major driver of equity returns but recommends adding AI-resilient quality (ARQ) stocks as ballast alongside AI beneficiaries.
ARQ stocks have business models largely independent of AI and focus on segments based on basic human needs.
The ARQ list comes from a screen of US companies that outperformed during significant AI sell-off events this year, narrowed by a quality overlay based on historical profit margin stability and ROIC.
Final list members must also be on US sector-specific CIO Equity Selection Lists. The list is not managed as an Equity Selection List.
UBS expects a broad-based deceleration in growth metrics from elevated levels (AI capex, profits, GDP, manufacturing activity), still above trend, and still expects 15% S&P 500 EPS growth in 2027.

As growth rates slow, market returns typically shift from higher-risk stocks to higher-quality stocks. Quality tends to outperform over the longer term and often does best later in the business cycle.

The AI trade is changing in two ways: investors weigh the return on AI investment spend (nearly USD 5 trillion cumulative capital by 2028), and AI model companies may take share from incumbents, especially in digital businesses.

Alphabet's 3Q26 search revenues were disappointing partly because of lower monetization of AI search queries. Meta's launch of its Muse AI consumer agent creates uncertainty for digital advertising and e-commerce. Software is likely not immune.
Effective 1 November 2026, UBS CIO no longer rates or ranks equities (Most Preferred, Bellwether, Least Preferred) or publishes top picks. It now uses a non-rating 'CIO Selected' designation.
earnings_insights: Alphabet 3Q26 search revenues were disappointing, partly from lower monetization of AI search queries (report gives no figures).

macro_indicators.interpretation: UBS still expects solid earnings growth despite decelerating growth metrics, a supportive backdrop for stocks.

trade_ideas.description: Add AI-resilient quality (ARQ) stocks from the UBS CIO Selected lists to complement existing AI beneficiary holdings in diversified portfolios
trade_ideas.rationale: ARQ stocks outperformed in AI sell-offs and quality tends to lead as growth decelerates later in the cycle.
trade_ideas.risk: Each stock has idiosyncratic risks, sentiment may keep shifting, and stocks may not have reached their lows.

risk_factors: Idiosyncratic risk in each listed stock.
Investor sentiment has shifted frequently this year and may cause ARQ stocks to underperform.

No guarantee markets, sectors or stocks have reached their lows. Further declines could come from weaker growth, higher-for-longer rates, changed inflation expectations, tighter financial conditions, geopolitical escalation or energy price shocks.
